## Summary of the last run

The page is a careful treatment of global plane curve theory. I checked the supplements, remarks, hypchecks and stated-only facts individually: the Whitney–Graustein remark, the Hopf 1935 attribution, the limacon vertex count (κ'=12 sin t(2+cos t)(5+4cos t)^{-5/2}, giving exactly 2 vertices), the 'convexity not essential' remark, and the angle-lifting hypcheck all appear correct. The proofs (Umlaufsatz normalization, convex characterization, four-vertex theorem) are logically sound; the terse 'similar' case in four-vertex Step 2 and the representative argument in Step 5 are acceptable. I found no genuine problem of the six specified kinds, so no new issues are reported.
